documents.text: FLEX-017 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 205.7kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.09/0.70 O2/N2/CO2, 3.0 atm ambient environment. documents.title: FLEX-018 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-018 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 206.7kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.21/0.09/0.70 O2/N2/CO2, 2.0 atm ambient environment. There is a luminous yellow flame immediately after ignition, with the HiBMS view showing significant soot formation. The luminous flame disappears with a dim blue flame surrounding the droplet. The flame oscillates and then appears to extinguish in both the LLUV and color camera views. The droplet continues to vaporize vigorously though and the radiometer does not settle to its baseline value. There is 'hazing' around the droplet in the HiBMS view during combustion, almost like there is significan

documents.title: FLEX-019 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-019 Heptane O2 34.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet is almost motionless after deployment, but then a large impulse when the igniters start to heat moves droplet SW and quickly out of HiBMS FOV. The droplet is nearly out of the FOV when the igniters begin to move away from the droplet. There is significant sooting with large aggregates. The data from this test are probably not reliable.

documents.title: FLEX-020 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-020 Methanol O2 34.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition. It is in the HiBMS for only a short time, and also drifts quickly out of the Color Camera FOV. It remains in the LLUV FOV for the entire burn and seems to burn to a very small extinction droplet size or completion.

documents.title: FLEX-021 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-021 Methanol O2 34.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction This is a freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. This was the first successful test after switching from the high CO2, high pressure ambients where we had significant deployment problems. The droplet has a high burning rate and stays in the HiBMS FOV the entire test. Before flame extinction, the droplet distorts and eventually shatters coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-022 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-022 Methanol O2 34.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Freely-floating methanol droplet droplet burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test and drifts slowly SSE during the test. The droplet begins to change shape, becomes almost oblong with a pointed end (from the video) before disrupting. The disruption is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-023 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-023 Heptane O2 34.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.37/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition. It drifts partially out of the FOV, but then drifts back in. Ther is significant sooting with large agglomerates throughout the test.

documents.title: FLEX-024 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-024 Heptane O2 34.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images for this test. There appeared to be a possible needle fire. The color camera and LLUV IPSUs stopped recording before the test was complete. The LLUV images were recorded at 8-bit depth and no 12-bit which resulted in more uncertainty in the LLUV flame size measurements.

documents.title: FLEX-025 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-025 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition, leaving the FOV 1/2 through the burn before burning to near completion.

documents.title: FLEX-026 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-026 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.30/0.80 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NW out of the HiBMS FOV about half way through the burn. The droplet appears to burn to completion or a very small size before a disruption that causes flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-027 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-027 Heptane O2 30.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Freely-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient envirronment. The droplet drifts W in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the FOV 2/3rds of the way through the test. There is a bright luminous flame that dims to blue about 1/3 the way through the burn (the transition from luminous yellow to dim blue is relatively fast). There is significant sooting with large soot agglomerates present throughout the burn. There is a disruption that is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-028 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-028 Heptane O2 29.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Freely-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the FOV after approximately 2/3 of the burn is complete. There is a bright luminous flame that persists throughout the droplet lifetime. There is significant sooting with large soot agglomerates present throughout the burn. There is a disruption that is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-029 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-029 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.360/0.80 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/3 the way through the test. The droplet also drifts out of the color camera view before the flame extinguishes. The flame stays in the LLUV FOV for the entire test and does not appear to disrupt when the flame extinguishes. Based on the extrapolated droplet history and the duration of the burn, the droplet burned to completion or a very small droplet size.

documents.title: FLEX-030 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-030 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the FOV of all the cameras for the entire test. The droplet drifts S, then E, then N in the HiBMS FOV. Coincident with flame extinction, the droplet becomes almost 'football'-shaped. The oblong shape with a pointed end remains stationary and fixed for several seconds (until recording ended). The Dext is the actual extinction diameter, but may be influenced by the shape change.

documents.title: FLEX-031 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-031 Heptane O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S in the HiBMS FOV and leaves the FOV shortly after igniter withdraw. There is a significant amount of sooting and a large soot shell surrounding the droplet. The droplet drifts out of the color camera FOV, but starys in the LLUV FOV. The droplet burns to disruption at a small size.

documents.title: FLEX-032 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-032 Heptane O2 29.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Freely-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. Significant sooting with large agglomerates throughout the test. A very luminous flame that persists throughout the droplet lifetime until disruptive extinction. The droplet drifts NW out of the HiBMS FOV 1/3rd of the way through the test. It remains in the LLUV and color camera FOVs the entire test. The degree of sooting made accurate measurement of the droplet size difficult.

documents.title: FLEX-033 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-033 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.79 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts slighly N and then E in the HiBMS FOV. It evenutally leaves the HiBMS FOV, but well after extinction. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-034 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-034 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Freely-floating methanol droplet burning in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2, 1.0 atm) ambient environment. The droplet is almost motionless after deployment and ignition. It slowly starts drifting N in the HiBMS FOV, then starts moving N much quicker and out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/2 way through the test. The color camera IPSU did not record any images for this test. It is unclear from the LLUV whether the droplet disrupted coincident with flame extinction. There is no extinction droplet diameter listed since the droplet was out of the HiBMS FOV for such a long time near visible flame extinc

documents.title: FLEX-035 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-035 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2, 1.0 atm) ambient environment. The droplet stays in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test including a long time after visible flame extinction. The flame oscillates before visible flame extinction, apparent in both the LLUV and color camera views. After flame extinction, the droplet vaporizes very vigorously with a nearly perfectly linear D^2 vs. time behavior. The vaporization rate is only slightly lower than the burning rate constant before flame extinction. The droplet vaporization rate then plateaus and this is coincident with t

documents.title: FLEX-036 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-036 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.79 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire burn and for several seconds after flame extinction. The droplet does not distort or disrupt.

documents.title: FLEX-037 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-037 Methanol O2 34.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Fiber-supported methanol droplet with ~ 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. After ignition and the start of translation, there is significnat transverse motion. There is a lot of scatter in the droplet history because of the droplet motion on the fiber. The flame view shows a bright flame with A LOT of sparklers throughout the burn. The transverse droplet motion becomes more severe towards the end of the test, with the droplet deforming. Flame extinction is coincident with a complete dropl

documents.title: FLEX-038 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-038 Methanol O2 34.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with translation burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient. The droplet burn is very smooth with little motion of the droplet relative to the fiber for most of the test. About 80% of the way through the burn the droplet begins transverse vibrations on the fiber. The vibrations grow in magnitude until the droplet disrupts and disintegrates, extinguishing the flame and leaving no fuel droplet on the fiber. The LLUV IPSU stopped recording for about 1/2 of the test (in the middle).

documents.title: FLEX-039 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-039 Heptane O2 34.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.34/0.66 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is significant transverse and axial oscillations on the fiber during the entire burn although the droplet remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. There is significant sooting with large aggregates throughout the entire test. The sooting is high enough that the threshold intensity for droplet discrimination had to be reduced to get reasonable droplet size measurements. The flame is bright yellow and very luminous the entire test. There is a disruption that disloc

documents.title: FLEX-040 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-040 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet has some transverse oscillations after ignition. The transverse oscillations diminish relatively quickly. During and after translation the droplet oscillates axially. It moves into and partially out of the HiBMS FOV (to the E). The droplet stops moving both transversely and axially and burns smoothly eventually shrinking until it is fully in the HiBMS FOV. Near the end of the test the droplet begins to oscillate on the fiber and disrupts, dislodging from the fiber an

documents.title: FLEX-041 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-041 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet exhibits significant axial oscillations during and after the start and stop of fiber translation. The droplet drifts in and partially out of the HiBMS FOV. At the end of the test, the droplet swells, disrupts and becomes dislodged from the fiber. The disruption is coincident with flame extinction (the dislodged droplet does burn as it drifts away). The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment.

documents.title: FLEX-042 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-042 Heptane O2 30.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet is relatively heavily sooting immediately after ignition. Shortly after ignition the droplet begins to severely distort, periodically expelling small droplets of fuel that continue to burn. There is a large disruption that completely dislodges the droplet from the fiber. This droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV, then S (after another disruption) and then burns relatively cleanly to disruption at a small size. The burning rate constant is that during the relatively clean period after the drople

documents.title: FLEX-043 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-043 Heptane O2 30.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. There is significant sooting. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV the entire test until the droplet disrupts and dislodges from the fiber. There is significant oscillatory axial motion on the fiber during the entire test.

documents.title: FLEX-044 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-044 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There is some transverse motion after deployment that persists throughout the test. There is also significant oscillatory axial motion during the translation that persists after the fiber stops translating. The droplet drifts axially out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/3rd of the way through the burn. There is significant 'sparkling' evident in the color camera view. It is not visible in either the HiBMS or LLUV. The droplet disrupts and becomes dislodged from the fiber coincident wit

documents.title: FLEX-045 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-045 Methanol O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. There is some axial and transverse droplet motion from deployment until the end of the test. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment. The extinction droplet diameter is the droplet diameter when the droplet disrupts and becomes dislodged from the fiber. The disruption is coincident with flame extinction. There is some droplet swelling or shape change before disruption.

documents.title: FLEX-046 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-046 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet burning in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. There is significant oscillatory axial motion during the most of the test. At the very end, the droplet does become stationary. There is some deformation/growth/shape change at the end of the test. There is a small disruption that is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-047 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-047 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts E out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/2 the way through the test. The flame oscillates for several seconds before leaving the FOV of all the cameras. It leaves the LLUV FOV last, and is oscillating as it translates S out of the FOV. The radiometer shows flame persists even after leaving the FOV. Extrapolating the burning history to when the radiometer indicates extinction (with large error bars) shows that the droplet burns nearly to extinction. There is no evidence of disruptiv

documents.title: FLEX-048 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-048 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts E after the start of translation and out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/5th of the way through the test. The flame remains with the LLUV and color camera FOVs for the entire test. There is disruptive burning at the end of the test.

documents.title: FLEX-049 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-049 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1 atm ambient. The HiBMS IPSU stopped recording for a few seconds which resulted in a gap in the droplet history. The droplet oscillates on the fiber throughout the test, with the amplitude and frequency changing. There is also some unusual gas-phase recirculation evident from soot particle motion. The droplet vaporizes vigorously after visible flame extinction. There is also a large vapor cloud formed near the end of the recording period. This is evidence of cool flame burning and extinction follow

documents.title: FLEX-050 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-050 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1 atm ambient. There are moderate transverse oscillations on the fiber throughout the test. There is unique circulation patterns in the gas phase evident from the soot motion. The droplet continues to vaporize linearly after visible flame extinction and there is a large vapor cloud formed nearly coincident with a plateau in the droplet history. This is evidence of cool flame burning and extinction following visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-051 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-051 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a nominally air (0.21/0.79 O2/N2), 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV the entire test and burns to completion. There is a very luminous flame initially and that abruptly disappears half way through the burn. There are significant transverse oscillations of the droplet on the fiber although it never becomes dislodged from the fiber.

documents.title: FLEX-052 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-052 Heptane O2 30.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.30/0.70 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There are significant oscillations on the fiber throughout the burn. There is also significant sooting with large agglomerated stuck to the fiber (which creates scatter in the droplet history). The droplet drifts partially out of the HiBMS FOV for a short time before moving back in. There are significant oscillations, shape changes abd ejection of material from the droplet late in the test that ends with a disruption.

documents.title: FLEX-053 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-053 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.21/0.79 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There was no HiBMS data for this test. There was poor alignment between the needle and the droplet and the droplet did not get deployed on the fiber. It drifted N in the color camera FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the FOV before the end of the test. The droplet stayed in the LLUV FOV the entire test. The discrepancy in the flame size between the LLUV and color camera is because the flame is much brighter at the leading edge than the trailing edge and that results in a some of the flame bein

documents.title: FLEX-054 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-054 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-flaoating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.80 O2/N2 , 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet has almost no residual motion after ignition. About 1/2 way though the test, the droplet begins to abruptly move NEE and then quickly changes direction to NE. The droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV after the second change in direction. It appears from the color camera that there may be some small gas bubbles in the droplet. There is also some distortion in the droplet history right before the droplet changes direction. This could be due to the expanding gas bubbles distorting the droplet, then bur

documents.title: FLEX-055 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-055 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.20/0.80 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. After the start of translation, the droplet oscillates rapidly between where the flame impinges on the fiber. The oscillation stops at approximately halfway through the test. The periodic noise in the droplet history is caused by the oscillation. The droplet then grows and has a small disruption leaving a small residual droplet on the fiber. The burst or disruption is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-056 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-056 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 73.0kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.80 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts E after ignition and leaves the HiBMS FOV shortly after visible flame extinction. The droplet the re-enters the HiBMS FOV from the E a few seconds prior to the stop of video recording. There is vapor cloud formation in the color camera view approximately 20 sec after visible flame extinction. It is not clear whether cool flame burning and extinction occurred for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-057 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-057 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 73.0kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.20/0.80 O2/N2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is moderate transverse and axial oscillations on the fiber after deployment and during the entire visible flame and after visible flame extinction. The flame extinguishes after the translation stops, with the trailing edge of the flame visibly weaker and extinguishing first. There are unusual, recirculating flow patterns in the HiBMS fuel from soot that moves toward the droplet, accelerates circuferentially a short arc and then goes radially towards the flame and back aga

documents.title: FLEX-058 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-058 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 103.4kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2 ambient, 1.0 atm ambient. The droplet slowly drifts E out of the HiBMS FOV accelerating slowly before leaving the FOV. The droplet remains in the LLUV and color camera FOVs for the entire test. There is no disruption. There is no extinction droplet diameter listed because the droplet is not in the HiBMS FOV for the majority of the burning history.

documents.title: FLEX-059 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-059 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV the entire test, drifting N after deployment, stopping, drifting SW to the corner of the FOV and then N to the middle W of the FOV. The color camera IPSU did not record any images for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-060 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-060 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 103.4kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/s translation burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet moves E in the HiBMS FOV with translation and continues to move E along the fiber and out of the FOV after the translation stops. It also drifts partially out of the LLUV FOV. The droplet then oscillates between the regions of the fiber where the flame impinges on it for several seconds before becoming quiescent and burning until, presumabley diffusive, flame extinction. There was no apparent disruption at or near flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-061 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-061 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 103.4kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with no translation burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient. The droplet remains stationary on the fiber and within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The flame is very dim in both the LLUV and color camera views.

documents.title: FLEX-062 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-062 Heptane O2 18.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet is nearly motionless after deployment and ignition and stays in the FOVs of all the cameras for the entire test. The HiBMS IPSU stopped recording images for a short time after visible flame extinction. There is continued rapid vaporization after visible flame extinction and the formation of a large vapor cloud. This is indicative of cool flame burning and extinction following visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-063 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-063 Heptane O2 18.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the FOV 2/3rds of the through the test. There is a small disruption near the end of the test. Extrapolating the droplet history using the average burning rate constant shows a very small extinction droplet size, indicating the droplet burned essentially to completion.

documents.title: FLEX-064 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-064 Heptane O2 18.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation (for approximately 4 sec) burning in a 0.18/0.82 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The flame has moderate transverse oscillations and remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The flame grows and becomes dim blue. During translation, the leading edge of the flame is bright and the fiber glows brightly. The trailing edge of the flame is much dimmer and the fiber does not glow. After translation stops, the flame extinguishes. There is significant droplet vaporization after visible flame extinction. There is a small disruption ve

documents.title: FLEX-065 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-065 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts SSE and out of the HiBMS FOV before the end of the test. The color camera IPSU did not record any images for this test. The LLUV shows a very long burn with a flame that appears to get a little bit brighter for a short period of time. There is no extinction droplet diameter listed because the droplet is out of the HiBMS FOV for most of the droplet lifetime.

documents.title: FLEX-066 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-066 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts SE and out of the HiBMS FOV, but then drifts back into the FOV a few seconds prior to flame extinction. There is a droplet shape change with the apparent ejection of some material during ignition. The droplet shape oscillates immediately after this. The color camera IPSU did not record any images for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-067 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-067 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts slowly E and then SE and out of the HiBMS FOV, but not until after flame extinction. The flame oscillates significantly before extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-068 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-068 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N slowly, the turns S and drifts slowly before accelerating out of the FOV right after visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-069 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-069 Heptane O2 14.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with no translation burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There is siginficant droplet motion during the entire, very short burn. There appears to be some visible distortions where the droplet edge intersects the fiber. This was a small droplet with significant motion on fiber that had a large influence on the burning characteristics.

documents.title: FLEX-070 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-070 Heptane O2 15.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There was extra fuel dispensed after the automated sequence started. The droplet drifts NW in the HiBMS FOV after deployment, hits the upper igniter and then quickly drifts SE and out of the HiBMS FOV. The post deployment/ignition velocity is quite high, approximately 8 mm/sec. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment. It is unknown whether there was cool flame burning and extinction for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-071 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-071 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet has a high drift velocity to the N after deployment. The droplet hits the igniter and then continues to move NNW after ignition at approx 7 - 8 mm/sec. It leaves the HiBMS FOV relatively quickly and well before flame extinction. There is no extinction droplet diameter listed since the droplet was out of the HiBMS FOV for most of the burn. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment for this test.

documents.title: FLEX-072 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-072 Heptane O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. This is a very small droplet, smaller than would be typically recommended to burn in the apparatus. The droplet drifts NNW in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition with a significant (7 - 8 mm/sec) velocity and leaves the FOV before the test is complete. The droplet burns to completion without disruption with a dim blue flame and only a little luminous region after ignition.

documents.title: FLEX-073 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-073 Heptane O2 15.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There was an error in the automated test sequence and the MDCA dispensed fuel before deployment. The result was a very large droplet, much larger than intended. The droplet drifts NW in the HiBMS FOV after deployment, then hits the igniter and starts to drift SE and quickly out of the FOV. The droplet lifetime is very short with flame extinction occurring only a few seconds after igniter withdraw. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment. There is not enough evidence to know whether

documents.title: FLEX-074 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-074 Heptane O2 15.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.15/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There are significant oscillation on the fiber after deployment that persist throughout the burn. The oscillations cause the droplet to become misshapen and cause large errors/scatter in the droplet size measurement. This is a very short burn and although there is not a large disruption, the oscillations compromise the data from the test.

documents.title: FLEX-075 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-075 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.13/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. After deployment, there is some transverse, but no axial motion along fiber. The transverse motion persists throughout the test, but stops after flame extinction. There is no axial motion relative to the fiber, the droplet starts and stops with the start and stop of the fiber. There is no disruption during this test.

documents.title: FLEX-076 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-076 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet burning in a 0.14/0.86 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet oscillates axially on the fiber throughout the flame lifetime, only becoming quiescient after visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-077 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-077 Methanol O2 14.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.14/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There was very little droplet motion after deployment and ignition (it only moved a few mm during the entire test).

documents.title: FLEX-078 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-078 Methanol O2 14.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.14/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There was very little droplet motion after ignition. Halfway through the burn, the droplet begins to drift E at approximately 3 mm/sec. It drifts out of the HiBMS FOV just before flame extinction. The extinction droplet diameter is extrapolated from the droplet history and the measured average burning rate constant just prior to the droplet leaving the HiBMS FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-079 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-079 Heptane O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.13/0.85 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. Very short burn that is entirely transient. This ambient is likely below the quasi-steady flammability limit. There is a small vapor cloud that forms shortly after visible flame extinction. This may be indicative of cool flame burning and extinction following hot flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-080 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-080 Heptane O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images for this test. This was a very short flame lifetime with the flame extinguishing before the droplet started translating. There was a small vapor cloud formed some time after visible flame extinction. It is unclear whether there was cool flame burning and extinction following visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-081 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-081 Heptane O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images and the color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment. This was a very short burn with almost no burning after igniter withdraw.

documents.title: FLEX-082 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-082 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. Very good deployment and ignition with almost no residual motion. The droplet does drift S in the HiBMS and out of the FOV, but not until well after flame extinction. This was a very dim flame.

documents.title: FLEX-083 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-083 Methanol O2 12.0% pressure 103.4kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.12/0.88 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images for this test. The droplet does not drift after deployment and ignition and stays in the FOVs of both the LLUV and color cameras. The flame is very dim and almost undetectable by the LLUV (especially later in the flame lifetime). As a result, the LLUV flame size measurements for the last half of the test are not accurate (the flame essentially undetectable by the LLUV).

documents.title: FLEX-084 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-084 Methanol O2 12.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition (deployment-induced motion) and out of the HiBMS FOV halfway through the test. The flame stays within the LLUV and color camera FOVs the entire test. The droplet burns for a long time in this ambient environment. The extinction droplet diameter is based on extrapolating the droplet history using the measured burning rate constant while the droplet is within the HiBMS FOV. The flame was very dim and the LLUV flame data is not as reliable because of the int

documents.title: FLEX-085 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-085 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NW in the HiBMS FOV and out of the FOV about half way through the test. The flame stays within the LLUV and color camera FOVs for the entire test. The extinction droplet diameter is based on extrapolating the droplet history using the known burning rate constant from droplet history just prior to the droplet leaving the HiBMS FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-086 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-086 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet oscillates transversely on fiber throughout the test. It continues to move (relative to the fiber) even after the fiber stops translating. It drifts out of the HiBMS FOV and to the edge of the LLUV FOV. Only about half the test is captured by the HiBMS. The color camera IPSU did not any images after deployment. The extinction droplet diameter is based on extrapolating the droplet history using the measured burning rate constant while the droplet is within the HiBMS

documents.title: FLEX-087 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-087 Methanol O2 13.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with no translation in a 0.13/0.87 O2/N2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. After deployment and ignition, there are significant axial oscillations along fiber axis throughout the burn. The osciallations are significant and persistent. The droplet remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The droplet burns for a relatively long time in this low O2 ambient. The flame was very dim and the LLUV flame size measurements are not reliable.

documents.title: FLEX-088 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-088 Methanol O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.25/0.60/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet deploys and ignites with almost no residual motion. It stays within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The droplet burns cleanly with a brighter blue flame the entire test. Near the end of test, there is droplet deformation (becoming football shaped), and then disruption that is coincident with flame extinction. The droplet shatters at the end of the test. The end of the test is likely compromised by the conformal coating needle contamination.

documents.title: FLEX-089 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-089 Methanol O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.25/0.60/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet slowly drifts E in the HiBMS FOV and out of the FOV before the test ends. Just as the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV, the liquid starts to oscillate slightly; the motion is visible in the color camera view. The flame extinguishes abruptly, and is likely due to disruption.

documents.title: FLEX-090 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-090 Methanol O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Fiber-supported methanol droplet with no translation in a 0.25/0.60/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is significant axial and transverse oscillations on the fiber after ignition. While the droplet is oscillating on the fiber, there are 'sparklers' evident on the color camera view. The oscillations diminish and the droplet burns cleanly (on the color camera view as well). A few seconds before there is a disruption (without dislocation) and then a complete disruption/dislocation/flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-091 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-091 Methanol O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation in a 0.25/0.60/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There are moderate axial oscillations on the fiber (lower frequency than some of the tests with severe oscillations) while the droplet is translating. The oscillations stop and the droplet burns nicely until the end of the test when there is a disruption coincident with flame extinction. The increase in droplet size at the end of the test is likely the result of bubble nucleation and growth.

documents.title: FLEX-092 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-092 Heptane O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.14/0.86 O2/N2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N and out of the HiBMS FOV before the burn is complete (about 60% of the burn captured with HiBMS). The droplet burns for a very long time. The burn looks very clean, burns to a small size, with a disruption that is coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-093 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-093 Heptane O2 25.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is a lot of transverse and axial oscillatory motion during the entire droplet burn. The droplet does not leave the HiBMS FOV during the test, but the burning rate is high which is likely the result of the significant and high frequency oscillations.

documents.title: FLEX-094 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-094 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.27/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition and out of the HiBMS FOV shortly after visible flame extinction. Some time after visible flame extinction there is a large vapor cloud of (presumable) formed. This is indicative of cool flame burning and extinction following visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-095 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-095 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation (for approximately 4 seconds) burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is very little axial or transverse oscillation on the fiber and the droplet stays within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The visible flame extinguishes shortly after the fiber translation stops. The droplet continues to vaporize at a relatively high rate after visible flame extinction and then there is some axial oscillation on the fiber, followed by a significant reduction in the vaporization rate. The marked decrease in vaporiza

documents.title: FLEX-096 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-096 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images for this test. There were significant oscillations on fiber, so severe that the droplet became dislodged from the fiber and drifted S and out of the color camera FOV. It also drifted out of the LLUV FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-097 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-097 Methanol O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N with a relatively high velocity in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition, and out of the FOV shortly after ignition. It appears that the droplet drifts close enough to the needle to start a needle fire that changes the droplet direction from N to E in the color camera FOV. The droplet quickly leaves the color camera FOV while still burning. The droplet remains in the LLUV FOV drifting S after deployment and ignition. The needle fire is visible on the LLUV as well and i

documents.title: FLEX-098 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-098 Methanol O2 23.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition, to the edge of the FOV, then E and out of HiBMS FOV before end of test. The flame 'swirls' a little before extinction in both LLUV and color camera. The droplet was not in the HiBMS FOV long enough to get an accurate estimate of the extinction droplet diameter.

documents.title: FLEX-099 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-099 Methanol O2 23.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N and out of the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition The droplet appears to drift close to the needle (no fire) in the color camera view and gets pushed away slightly. It remains in both the LLUV and color camera FOVs until flame extinction. The droplet is not in the HiBMS FOV long enough to get a good estimate of the extinction droplet diameter.

documents.title: FLEX-100 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-100 Heptane O2 23.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition, and out of HiBMS FOV just after visible flame extinction. The flame radiatively extinguishes at a relatively large droplet size. There is a vapor cloud formation approximately 15 sec after visible flame extinction. The vapor cloud is indicative of cool flame burning and extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-101 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-101 Heptane O2 23.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation (for approximately 4 seconds) burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is only a little axial and transverse oscillation after deployment and ignition and druing translation of the fiber, but for most of the burn and post-burn, the droplet is relatively quiescent. The droplet remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire recording duration of HiBMS IPSU-1. The flame radiatively extinguishes, preferentially along the fiber axis. The droplet continues to vaporize at a high rate after visible flame extinction. T

documents.title: FLEX-102 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-102 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the HiBMS FOV shortly after visible flame extinction. The color camera IPSU failed to record any images after droplet deployment. The flame radiatively extinguishes and there is a vapor cloud visible on the downlink video some time after visible flame extinction. This is indicative of cool flame burning and extinction following visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-103 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-103 Heptane O2 21.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet moves axially on the fiber a short distance after translation stops and partially out of the HiBMS FOV. By the end of the HiBMS IPSU-1 recording it moves completely back into the HiBMS FOV. There is a small droplet or debris on the fiber that ignites and briefly burns (burns out) before the flame extinguishes. The flame radiatively extinguishes before translation stops. The droplet continues to vaporize at a relatively high rate and the vaporization rate slows which

documents.title: FLEX-104 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-104 Methanol O2 23.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition and out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/3rd of the way through the test. The color camera IPSU-4 did not record any images after deployment. The droplet burns to diffusive extinction without disruption. There is no extinction droplet diameter reported since the droplet was within the HiBMS FOV for such a short fraction of the burn time.

documents.title: FLEX-105 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-105 Methanol O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is significant axial oscillatory motion on the fiber after deployment and igntion that persists after fiber translation stops about halfway through the flame lifetime. The droplet then burns without axial or transverse motion until it disrupts and dislocated from the fiber coincident with flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-106 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-106 Methanol O2 23.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet moves W along the fiber a short distance after deployment and ignition but before translation and then moves E with the fiber during translation. The droplet remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. There is very little motion of the droplet relative to the fiber during the test. There is a small disruption coincindent with flame extinction that leaves a slightly smaller droplet on the fiber. The extinction droplet diameter is the droplet diameter

documents.title: FLEX-107 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-107 Methanol O2 24.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is not much axial oscillatory motion associated with fiber motion but some transverse oscillations. The droplet disrupts right around the time of extinction. There is no shape change prior to disruption.

documents.title: FLEX-108 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-108 Methanol O2 23.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.23/0.52/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There was significant oscillatory motion of the droplet on the fiber during the burn both before and after the translation. The droplet swells and eventually disrupts before flame extinction leaving a small residual droplet on the fiber.

documents.title: FLEX-109 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-109 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning inb a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays in the HiBMS and color camera FOVs for the entire IPSU recording time (evan after visible flame extinction). The LLUV IPSU did not record any images for this test. The droplet deforms (becomes aspherical) right around extinction and remains mishapen after the flame extinguishes. There may be fuel contamination issues with this test.

documents.title: FLEX-110 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-110 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains within the FOV of all cameras and burns to diffusive extinction. The LLUV data has a lot of noise associated with the very dim flame and the smudge on the CIR LLUV viewing window.

documents.title: FLEX-111 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-111 Methanol O2 21.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment with fiber translation after ignition. An almost ideal fiber supported test with almost no oscillation of the droplet. The fiber started and stopped moving with almost no relative motion imparted to the droplet.

documents.title: FLEX-112 (?)
documents.text: FLEX-112  O2 0.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fber-supported methanol droplet burning in a 0.21/0.49/0.30 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There was no fiber translation on this test. The droplet initially moves W in the HiBMS FOV before stopping and then slowly moving back to the center of the image. There is a little disruption (maybe a small gas bubble popping) near flame extinction that is coincident with a small sattelite droplet being ejected from the droplet.

documents.title: FLEX-113 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-113 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.35 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient enviornment. The droplet drifts NW after deployment in the HiBMS FOV, hits the igniter and then drifts SE after ignition and out of the FOV approximately 8 sec after igniter withdraw. The droplet burns with a very weak relatively steady flame for a long period of time before oscillating before extinction. The extinction droplet diameter is based on extrapolating the droplet history to the time of extinction using the measured burning rate constant from just before when the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-114 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-114 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure NonekPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.35 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. After ignition the droplet drifts NE and out of the HiBMS FOV. The droplet remains out of the FOV until near the end of the test when it drifts back in from the NE corner. The droplet drifts back in the FOV just before flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-115 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-115 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.35 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There is a small residue on the fiber to the W of the droplet that ignites a few sec after droplet ignition. This residue burns for 1 - 2 sec with a very bright luminous flame (during translation). The droplet drifts partially out of the HiBMS FOV after the translation stops, then shrinks back to be completely in the FOV. There appears to be some oscillations near extinction. The droplet burns without transverse or axial oscillations along the fiber. There is no disru

documents.title: FLEX-116 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-116 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet (translated for approximately 3 sec. immediately after ignition) burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.35 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. This was a very clean test with very little droplet motion on the fiber.

documents.title: FLEX-117 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-117 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.35 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N in the HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition and out of the FOV after visible flame extinction. The droplet has a very low burning rate constant. A relatively large vapor cloud forms well after visible flame extinction which indicates likely cool flame burning and extinction after visible flame extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-118 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-118 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.45/0.25 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet ignites and shortly after ignition a small droplet or debris ignites to the W (color camera) or N (LLUV) of the droplet. This small droplet/particle burns for only a short time. It is not visible in the HiBMS. The droplet burns for only a short time before radiatively extinguishing. There is continued rapid vaporization after visible flame exinction, followed by avapor cloud formation approximately 5 seconds after visible flame extinction. This is an indication of cool flame burning

documents.title: FLEX-119 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-119 Heptane O2 18.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. After ignition the flame quickly extinguishes. This is likely radiative extinction and it is quite possible this ambient condition is below the flammability limit for heptane. The droplet has some unusual oscillations on the fiber during the burn that seem to disappear for most of the test (after the flame extinguishes). The color camera IPSU did not record any images for this test. There is a brief period of significant vaporization after visible flame extinction followed by formation of a sma

documents.title: FLEX-120 (?)
documents.text: FLEX-120  O2 0.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with fiber translation burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet does not oscillate much on the fiber during or after the burn. There is s small vapor cloud formed after visible flame extinction. It is difficult to determine whether there was cool flame burning and extinction from the available data. The LLUV IPSU did not record any images during the burn.

documents.title: FLEX-121 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-121 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 69.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet does not drift at all in any of the camera FOVs after deployment and ignition. The flame oscillates a few times before radiatively extinguishing. The color camera flame data is more reliable in this test as it was easier to distinguish the flame boundaries.

documents.title: FLEX-122 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-122 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. The droplet is almost motionless after deployment and ignition. It then slowly drifts S and eventually out of the HiBMS FOV, but after flame extinction. The flame appears to radially oscillate (primarily in intensity) a few seconds before extinction. The droplet burns for about 15 sec and the flame appears weak but persists for quite a while. Nice clean burn with no distortion or disruption.

documents.title: FLEX-123 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-123 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. There was no fiber translation. Large droplet appears to radiatively extinguish. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment. The LLUV IPSU lost data for about 5 sec during the test. The LLUV images are very dim and it was almost impossible to detect the edges of the flame. The flame appeared on the LLUV view to be quenched where the flame and fiber met.

documents.title: FLEX-124 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-124 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.42/0.40 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays in the FOVs of all that cameras for the entire burn. The droplet burnis for a short time to likely radiative extinction.

documents.title: FLEX-125 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-125 Methanol O2 17.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient evnironment. The droplet stays in the FOV of all cameras after deployment and ignition. The flame oscillates for one or two cycles before radiatively extinguishing. This condition is very near, if not over, the flammability limit. The Color Camera flame size data is a bit more reliable than the LLUV which had a lot of noise and a flame that was barely distinguishable from the background.

documents.title: FLEX-126 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-126 Methanol O2 17.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays within the FOV of all cameras after deployment and ignition. The droplet burns a relatively long time and appears to diffusively extinguish.

documents.title: FLEX-127 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-127 Methanol O2 17.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported methanol with no translation burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet remains within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test. The flame then becomes very dim blue and is nearly cylindrical because of the flame quenching due to the support fiber. There is little fiber glow after the droplet stops translating and from the flame measurements from the color camera, there are periodic oscillations of the flame size after the droplet stops translating. The HiBMS IPSU stopped recording for a relatively large block of time just before igniter withdraw

documents.title: FLEX-129 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-129 Heptane O2 17.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays in the FOVs of all the cameras for the very short burn and for a considerable period of time after visible flame extinction. The LLUV stopped recording images for several seconds right around ignition. This was a very short burn with no appreciable vaporization or vapor cloud formation after visible flame extinction. There was likely no cool flame or only a very brief cool flame.

documents.title: FLEX-130 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-130 Heptane O2 17.0% pressure 71.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with 3 mm/sec translation burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.7 atm ambient environment. This is a very short burn, radiative extinction with the flame extinguishing very quickly after translation starts. Ther is no vapor cloud formation and the vaporization rate after visible flame extinction is quite small. As a result, there is likely no, or only very brief, cool flame burning.

documents.title: FLEX-131 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-131 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. This is a smaller droplet that stays in the FOVs of all the cameras for the entire test. The droplet burns to disruptive extinction at a small size.

documents.title: FLEX-132 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-132 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NE after ignition, but slowly and remains in the FOV for the entire test. The droplet is initially luminous with a bight yellow flame that eventually turns blue with a little yellow and then blue until the end of the test. The droplet burns to a small size before a small disruption coincident with flame extinction. The LLUV IPSU-2 stopped recording for about 7 seconds in the middle of the test.

documents.title: FLEX-133 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-133 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NW and out of the HiBMS FOV before the end of the test (about half way). After ignition, the droplet flame is luminous, quickly changing to a nearly all blue, dim flame. The flame then begins to oscillate for several seconds before becoming stable and brighter and burning until a small disurption coincident with flame extinction. The extinction droplet diameter is the droplet diameter when the flame disrupts and is estimated from the burning rate constant while the droplet is within the

documents.title: FLEX-134 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-134 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There were problems with gas bubbles during the dispense/stretch/deployment. On this test there was a small gas bubble that burst during ignition and caused the droplet to oscillate. The droplet drifts slowly SSE and out of the HiBMS FOV a few seconds after radiative extinction. The droplet continues to vaporize at a relatively high rate after flame extinction although there are only a few seconds before the droplet left the HiBMS FOV. There is a vapor cloud that forms 10 - 20 seconds after visible flame

documents.title: FLEX-135 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-135 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Fiber-supported heptane droplet with no translation in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. There is a small droplet to the W of the main droplet that ignited and quickly burned off. There is significant transverse and axial motion of the droplet on the fiber during most of the test. The droplet drifted W on the fiber after deployment, but then stopped and oscillated (irregularly) axially and transversly during the entire burn. There was a brief shape change from spherical at the time of the discrete change in droplet size that corresponded to something being ejected from t

documents.title: FLEX-136 (?)
documents.text: FLEX-136  O2 0.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NW in the HiBMS view after deployment, then hits the igniter and moves in the NE direction and out of the HiBMS FOV. There is no extinction droplet diameter reported because the droplet is in the HiBMS FOV for such a small fraction of the droplet lifetime. It is unclear whether the droplet burned to completion of the flame extinguished at a finite droplet size, although given the ambient conditions and expected burning behavior, burnout is more likely.

documents.title: FLEX-137 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-137 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NW and out of the HiBMS FOV about half way through the test. After deployment, there is a disruption (maybe a bubble burst since these droplets had issues with gas bubbles) that causes significant droplet deformation and oscillations. There is a moderate degree of sooting. The droplet burns to a relatively small size before disruptive extinction. The noise in the beginning of the droplet history is due to soot influencing the droplet size measurement. The color camera IPSU faile

documents.title: FLEX-138 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-138 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome disruption Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The HiBMS IPSU did not record any images for this test. The flame grew in size initially, got very dim, but then shranks, got brighter and burned to disruption at a small size.

documents.title: FLEX-139 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-139 Heptane O2 24.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.24/0.56/0.20 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet deforms shortly after deployment, presumably due to a gas bubble that burst. This causes the droplet to drift slowly NE in the HiBMS. The droplet then had a large flash coincident with ignition that caused the droplet to drift SW at approximately 6 mm/sec. The droplet drifts with a constant trajectory until it leaves the HiBMS FOV about half way through the test. The burning rate is relatively high, and the flame is distorted with the large drift velocity. The droplet burns to a small

documents.title: FLEX-140 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-140 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.35/0.50 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet has a very small S drift after deployment and ignition, but remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire recording time. Very short burn, with the droplet being either significantly larger than the radiative extinction limit or completely outside the quasi-steady flammability boundary.

documents.title: FLEX-141 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-141 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.35/0.50 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts slowly S but remains in the HiBMS FOV for the entire test and well after flame extinction. The droplet abruptly leaves the HiBMS FOV in the video, likely because the HiBMS stopped archiving images for a short time. Very short burn, either radiative extinction or outside the quasi-steady flammability boundary all together.

documents.title: FLEX-142 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-142 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.35/0.50 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet deploys with a relatively high (~ 6 mm/sec) NW drift velocity. The burn time is relatively short and the droplet stays within the HiBMS FOV for the entire test.

documents.title: FLEX-143 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-143 Methanol O2 15.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.15/0.35/0.50 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition and out of the HiBMS FOV after flame extinction. It then drifts back into the HiBMS FOV before IPSU-1 recording stopped (thus the gap in the droplet history below). This was a smaller droplet and a very short burn, likely outside quasi-steady flammability boundary, or more likely, right at the boundary.

documents.title: FLEX-144 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-144 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet is nearly motionless after deployment and ignition. Midway through the burn the droplet drifts S and leaves the HiBMS FOV just before the flame extinguishes. The droplet remains in the FOVs of the LLUV and color cameras. The extinction droplet diameter comes from extrapolating the droplet history from the time the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV until the time of flame extinction using the burning rate constant measured near the end of the time when the droplet is within the HiBMS FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-145 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-145 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet stays in the FOVs of all the cameras for the entire burn.

documents.title: FLEX-146 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-146 Methanol O2 20.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. This is a very large droplet that is nearly motionless after deployment and ignition. The droplet eventually drifts S in the HiBMS FOV and leaves the FOV a short time before flame extinction. The flame size from the color camera is a bit more reliable than the LLUV because of the very dim flame coupled with the contamination on the CIR LLUV viewing window. The extinction droplet diameter comes from extrapolating the droplet history from when the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV until the time of flam

documents.title: FLEX-147 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-147 Methanol O2 17.0% pressure 70.9kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.17/0.38/0.45 O2/N2/CO2, 0.70 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts SE at approximately 4 - 5 mm/sec (deployment-induced, changed direction at ignition) and out of the HiBMS FOV after a few seconds. The droplet remains in the LLUV and color camera FOVs for the entire test but is at the very edge of the FOVs of both cameras. The flame gets continually dimmer throughout the test. There is no extinction droplet diameter because the droplet is in the HiBMS FOV for such a small fraction of the burn.

documents.title: FLEX-148 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-148 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. Very little residual motion after deployment and ignition. The droplet stays in the FOVs of all the cameras for the entire test. The droplet burns cleanly to small size, then disrupts coincident with flame extinction. The extinction droplet size is the droplet size when the flame/droplet disrupts. The HiBMS IPSU (IPSU-1) stopped recording data sometime before deployment to partway through the burn. The plotted data uses the first measured droplet as time zero although the droplet was burning for s

documents.title: FLEX-149 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-149 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. Excellent deployment with almost no residual motion after deployment and ignition. The droplet drifts a little S in the HiBMS FOV but stays in the FOV of all cameras for the entire test. The droplet burns cleanly down to a small size where it disrupts coincident with flame extinction. The extinction droplet size is the droplet size when the disruption occurs.

documents.title: FLEX-150 (Heptane)
documents.text: FLEX-150 Heptane O2 20.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating heptane droplet burning in a 0.20/0.75/0.05 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient enviornment. The droplet drifts NW in HiBMS FOV after deployment and ignition, but remains in the FOV for the entire burn, but leaves the FOV shortly after visible flame extinction. The flame oscillates a few times before radiatively extinguishing. There is a vapor cloud that forms approximately 20 seconds after visible flame extinction. This is indicative of cool flame burning and extinction after visible flame extinction. The color camera IPSU did not record any images after deployment.

documents.title: FLEX-151 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-151 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 101.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome unknown Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.67/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts NE and out of the HiBMS FOV about 1/4 of the way through the burn. The droplet burned for a very long time. The flame was very dim and difficult to see, with significant noise in the LLUV using automated analysis and a very low threshold for manual analysis. The droplet starts to oscillate in the midway point of the burn for a few seconds, then burns with a steady flame until it oscillates again right before flame extinction. There is no extinction droplet diameter listed becau

documents.title: FLEX-152 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-152 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.67/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts S in the HiBMS FOV and leaves the FOV about 2/3rds of the way through the burn. The extinction droplet diameter comes from extrapolating the droplet history from the time the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV until the time of flame extinction using the burning rate constant from the droplet history for a short period of time before the droplet leaves the HiBMS FOV.

documents.title: FLEX-153 (Methanol)
documents.text: FLEX-153 Methanol O2 18.0% pressure 102.3kPa flow Nonecm/s outcome extinction Free-floating methanol droplet burning in a 0.18/0.67/0.15 O2/N2/CO2, 1.0 atm ambient environment. The droplet drifts N after deployment and ignition, then begins to drift back to the center.
